description: mode keep (default) leaves every layer where it is. mode scale multiplies the x, y, w and h of every layer by the ratio of the new size to the old, rounded half up; text sizes and stroke widths are not scaled. The size is 1 to 4096 on each side.
name: canvas.resize
summary: Changes the size of the canvas.

background.description: A colour (#RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA) or transparent; default #FFFFFF.

preset.description: A named size; give it or width and height.

template.description: Make a template: its text and image layers may be slots.

description: Gives a new document its size, from a preset (video_thumbnail 1280x720, square_post 1080x1080, vertical_cover 1080x1920) or from width and height (1 to 4096 each), its name and its background (a colour, default #FFFFFF, or transparent). template true makes a template whose text and image layers may be slots. Refused on a document that already has a canvas.
name: image.create
summary: Sets the canvas, name and background of a new image document.

index.description: Position among the siblings, 0 is the bottom; absent means on top.

parent.description: A group; absent means the top level.

description: A fill is a rectangle the size of the canvas that can be moved and resized like any layer.
name: layer.add_fill
summary: Adds a solid colour over the whole canvas.

asset.description: The sha256 content hash of an image in the workspace.

fit.description: contain (default) or cover, when no box is given.

index.description: Position among the siblings, 0 is the bottom; absent means on top.

parent.description: A group; absent means the top level.

slot.description: Make the layer an image slot of a template.

description: asset is the content hash of an image file already imported (media:import gives it). Without x, y, w and h the layer is the fit (contain by default, or cover) of the whole source on the canvas, centred. effective.layer_id names the layer.
name: layer.add_image
summary: Adds an image layer from a file of the workspace.

index.description: Position among the siblings, 0 is the bottom; absent means on top.

parent.description: A group; absent means the top level.

description: w and h are pixels. x and y default to centre the shape on the canvas, fill to #FFFFFF. radius is for rounded_rect only.
name: layer.add_shape
summary: Adds a rectangle, a rounded rectangle or an ellipse.

index.description: Position among the siblings, 0 is the bottom; absent means on top.

parent.description: A group; absent means the top level.

slot.description: Make the layer a text slot of a template.

text.description: Up to 2000 characters; an empty text is an empty slot.

w.description: The width the text wraps at; default 86% of the canvas.

description: The text wraps at w (default 86% of the canvas) and its box is measured, so h is the height of the text. x defaults to centre the box on the canvas and y to centre it vertically. style is a partial text style (font_family, font_weight, size, color, stroke_color, stroke_width, shadow_*, background_*, align, line_height, uppercase); max_width is not a text-layer key, w is.
name: layer.add_text
summary: Adds a text layer.

curve.description: Up to 8 points of 0 to 255, x increasing; an empty list removes the curve.

reset.description: Remove every adjustment; no other argument.

description: Each key given replaces that adjustment and the others stay; a value equal to its neutral one removes it. brightness, contrast, saturation, temperature and tint are -100 to 100, hue -180 to 180 degrees, exposure -300 to 300 hundredths of a stop. levels takes black (0 to 254), white (1 to 255, above black) and gamma (10 to 1000 hundredths, 100 is neutral); the keys left out keep their value. curve is up to 8 points {x, y} of 0 to 255 with x increasing, and an empty list removes it. reset true removes every adjustment. Not valid for a group.
name: layer.adjust
summary: Sets the brightness, contrast, saturation, temperature, tint, hue, exposure, levels or tone curve of a layer.

description: to is canvas or a layer id. horizontal puts the left edge, the centre or the right edge of each layer on that of the target; vertical the top, the middle or the bottom. The box of a group is the union of its children; rotation is ignored. At least one axis.
name: layer.align
summary: Aligns layers to the canvas or to another layer.

description: mode is normal, multiply, screen, overlay, soft_light, hard_light, darken, lighten, color_dodge, color_burn or difference; normal removes the mode. Not valid for a group.
name: layer.blend
summary: Sets the blend mode of a layer.

reset.description: Show the whole source again; no other argument.

description: x, y, w and h are pixels of the source and must lie inside it. The box of the layer keeps its size, so use layer.fit afterwards to keep the aspect. reset true shows the whole source again.
name: layer.crop
summary: Sets the part of the source an image layer shows.

description: The copy sits just above the original, moved by dx and dy (default 0). A slot is not copied: a slot name is unique in a document. effective.layer_id names the copy.
name: layer.duplicate
summary: Copies a layer with its whole subtree and new ids.

amount.description: Per cent: a colour filter 1 to 100, sharpen 1 to 300, vignette and grain 1 to 100, glow 1 to 400.

index.description: Position among the filters; absent means last.

radius.description: Pixels: blur and glow 1 to 100, sharpen 1 to 20.

description: kind is grayscale, sepia, invert, warm, cool, blur, sharpen, vignette, grain, shadow, glow or stroke; a layer has at most one filter of each kind and at most 8. The parameters left out take the defaults of the kind. Filters act in list order; index is the position of the new one (0 is the first to act, absent means last). Not valid for a group.
name: layer.filter_add
summary: Adds a filter to a layer: a colour filter, blur, sharpen, vignette, grain, shadow, glow or stroke.

description: index is the final position of the filter among the filters of the layer; the first acts first.
name: layer.filter_move
summary: Changes the place of a filter in the list of a layer.

description: kind names the filter.
name: layer.filter_remove
summary: Removes a filter of a layer.

amount.description: Per cent: a colour filter 1 to 100, sharpen 1 to 300, vignette and grain 1 to 100, glow 1 to 400.

radius.description: Pixels: blur and glow 1 to 100, sharpen 1 to 20.

description: kind names the filter; the parameters given replace the old ones and the others stay.
name: layer.filter_set
summary: Changes the parameters of a filter of a layer.

description: The aspect of an image layer is that of its crop (or of the source), of a shape or a fill that of its box. The result is centred on the target. A text layer and a group are sized with layer.transform.
name: layer.fit
summary: Scales a layer to cover or to be contained in the canvas or another layer.

layer_ids.description: 1 to 100 layers that share one parent.

description: The group takes the place of the topmost of the layers and they keep their relative order inside it. The group has an offset (x, y, 0 at first) added to its children and its opacity multiplies theirs.
name: layer.group
summary: Wraps layers that share one parent in a new group.

description: A layer with no mask is left as it is.
name: layer.mask_clear
summary: Removes the mask of a layer.

source.description: kind layer only: the id of another layer.

description: A shape mask is in thousandths of the box of the layer: x, y, w and h (default the whole box), radius (rounded_rect only, pixels), feather (the soft edge in pixels, 0 to 200) and invert. kind layer takes source, the id of another layer that is not a group and has no mask from a layer of its own, and invert: the layer shows only where the source has pixels. The old mask is replaced. Not valid for a group.
name: layer.mask_set
summary: Sets the mask of a layer: a rectangle, a rounded rectangle or an ellipse, or the alpha of another layer.

index.description: Final position among the siblings, 0 is the bottom; absent means on top.

parent.description: A group id, or root for the top level.

description: parent is a group id, or root for the top level; index is the final position among the new siblings, 0 is the bottom, and absent means on top. Without parent the layer stays in its group. A layer cannot be moved into itself or into its own descendants.
name: layer.move
summary: Changes the order or the group of a layer.

description: Undo puts the layer back. A group that holds a locked layer cannot be removed.
name: layer.remove
summary: Removes a layer and everything inside it.

asset.description: The sha256 content hash of the new image in the workspace.

description: asset is the content hash of an image file already imported. The layer keeps its id, name, slot, visibility, opacity, rotation, adjustments, filters, mask and blend. When the new file has the size of the old one the box and the crop stay as they were; otherwise the crop is removed and the box stays when the new file has its proportions, and is the largest box with the proportions of the new file that fits inside it, centred, when it has others. effective names layer_id, box and asset.
name: layer.replace_source
summary: Gives an image layer another file and keeps the layer.

slot.description: A template slot name; an empty string removes it.

description: opacity is a whole percent. A locked layer accepts this command, to unlock it. slot names a template slot (a text or an image layer; the name is unique in the document) and an empty slot removes it.
name: layer.set
summary: Sets the name, opacity, visibility, lock or slot of a layer.

stroke_color.description: A colour; an empty string removes it.

description: A fill layer takes only fill. A radius is valid with rounded_rect only, and changing the shape to another one removes a stored radius. An empty stroke_color removes the stroke colour.
name: layer.set_shape
summary: Changes the shape, colours, stroke or radius of a shape layer, or the colour of a fill.

reset_style.description: Empty the stored style before applying style.

style.description: A partial TextStyle, merged; null removes a key.

description: style is a partial text style merged key by key; a null value removes a key and reset_style empties the stored style first. The height of the box is measured again.
name: layer.set_text
summary: Changes the text or the style of a text layer.

description: x and y are the top left corner in pixels of the parent (the canvas, or the origin of the group); w and h the size; rotation whole degrees clockwise around the centre, -360 to 360. A group takes only x and y, which move all its children. Changing w of a text layer measures its height again unless h is given.
name: layer.transform
summary: Sets the position, size or rotation of a layer.

description: The children take the place of the group, their x and y gain the offset of the group and their opacity is multiplied by the group's (rounded half up).
name: layer.ungroup
summary: Replaces a group by its children.
